hard_gate_failures: Any animation without a reduced-motion path
A.notes: The design relies on generic fade-ups on scroll, but fails to provide a proper reduced-motion fallback, leaving the rooms section completely invisible when reduced motion is preferred. The CSS illustrations are overly simplistic and leave awkward blank spaces in the layout.

B.notes: An exceptionally well-crafted design that uses elegant typography and beautiful, theme-specific CSS artwork (arches, iron balconies, an abstract conch shell) to build a cohesive identity. The layout is meticulously structured, and the reduced-motion fallback is handled flawlessly, keeping all content visible and cleanly formatted.

raw.why: Site B delivers a stunning, fully realized identity with highly original CSS artwork and perfect typography, whereas Site A feels generic and suffers from a critical accessibility failure.
